data.name: JCI Roofing Company
data.address: 3108 Old Denton Rd Apt 115, Carrollton, TX 75007

reviews.text: James exceeded all expectations!  He worked with my claims adjuster to ensure that all our needed repairs were identified.  Then, his standards exceeded my hopes.  He stayed in touch and worked with our schedule to get all repairs completed.  We will recommend JCI Roofing to everyone.
reviews.author: Teresa Durham

reviews.text: I’m so grateful I found this company. James has done a couple of roofing jobs for me. He responded quickly to my inquiries, was absolutely right in his his assessment of an insurance issue and got the problems taken care of in a timely manner. I would recommend his company to anyone with roofing issues. In fact, I gave his contact info to my realtor who needs reliable professionals to refer his clients to if they have issues to take care of before selling.
reviews.author: bette belanger

reviews.text: I had a great experience working with James. It's nice to do business with a company where you can work directly with the owner. James handled a lot of the communication with my insurance company regarding payment and pricing. He took time to explain a type of repairs and adjustments he was making to my roof. I would highly recommend JCI Roofing if you need any type of roof repairs.
reviews.author: Jeremiah Bridges

reviews.text: The folks from JCI were awesome.  I called them after one of the big storms we had recently because i was certain i had roof damage.  I thought i was going to need a new roof.  James’ team came out the same day i called... inspected my roof and told me i did NOT need a new roof but instead a simple repair to the ridge... which they did right then.  I appreciated the fact that they were quick, priced well, and didn't sell me something i didn't need.  I give them my highest recommendation.
reviews.author: PE

reviews.text: I would very highly recommend JCI Roofing! James was very easy to work with. He and his crew got the shingle job done on my garage the day after I signed the agreement. Everything looks to be very high quality and we are very happy with it!
reviews.author: Johnny Loewen

reviews.text: James and JCI Roofing did an outstanding job replacing our roof and patio cover after the hail storm. James is friendly, knowledgable and helpful with both the repair process and dealing with your insurance company. I can't recommend JCI enough to anyone who needs roofing work whether your insurance is involved or not. Honest and upfront pricing, no games, quick communication, all you could ask for as a customer.
reviews.author: Zach Woosley

reviews.text: We were having trouble getting what we should from the insurance company after a bad hail storm in Dallas. James came in and worked with the adjuster to insure we were getting everything we were supposed to get. he is polite, knowledgeable, and really seeks to help his customers. He and his men worked hard in July heat to get the roof done in two days. When they finished our yard looked better than when they started. We re very fond of James and thankful he was there in our time of need. If you want an HONEST roofer who cares, call JCI Roofing.
reviews.author: Lauren Bristow

reviews.text: We've not had the best of luck with other contractors for household work.  We knew nothing about roofs but James was recommended by some friends.  James came in, explained everything clearly, and worked with the insurance company to make sure we were getting everything we were supposed to get (our roof was pretty old before the hail storms). He and his men worked hard to get the roof done between forecast bad weather.  And then the new hail storm came. James still came out and checked out our roof again, and we were lucky that we weren't badly hit. We're very pleased with James and thankful that we found someone very reliable. If you want an HONEST roofer, we'd wholeheartedly recommend James and JCI Roofing.
reviews.author: Timothy Whitehead
